## Community Blog post

Thanks for writing for the Kubuntu Community Blog.

**Guide:** [Write a Community Blog post](https://kubuntu.org/blog/write/) (step-by-step, including GitHub website-only path)

### Pull request basics

- [ ] Targets branch **`develop`** (not `main`)
- [ ] Post file is under `content/en/blog/` and ends in `.md`
- [ ] Filename is lowercase-hyphenated (e.g. `plasma-tip-overview.md`) — no spaces

### Frontmatter checklist

- [ ] `title` — clear headline
- [ ] `date` — `YYYY-MM-DD`
- [ ] `author` — display name for the byline
- [ ] `author_slug` — stable id, lowercase + hyphens only (same slug on every post you write)
- [ ] `author_url` — optional public profile link
- [ ] `description` — one-sentence summary
- [ ] `tags` — include at least `blog`
- [ ] `draft: false` when ready to publish

### First post under this author_slug?

- [ ] Added `content/en/blog/authors/<author_slug>/_index.md` with `layout: author` and matching `author_slug`
- [ ] Or I already have an author page from an earlier post

### Voice and links

- [ ] Written as **community voice** (not a Council / official Kubuntu statement)
- [ ] Official announcements still belong in `content/en/news/`, not here
- [ ] Points readers to [Kubuntu Discourse](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/c/flavors/kubuntu/187) for discussion where it helps

### Images (if any)

- [ ] Files live under `static/images/blog/`
- [ ] Referenced as `/images/blog/your-file.png` in the Markdown
- [ ] I own the rights or the image is freely licensed
